hero.headline: People operations, all in one place
hero.subhead: Plan hiring, run payroll, support wellbeing, and help people grow — one connected workspace for HR, managers, and every worker.
hero.ctaHint: Free to explore — just your email, no password

b1.title: One workspace, not ten tabs
b1.body: Hiring, rota, payroll, reviews, and wellbeing live together, so nothing falls through the cracks between tools.

b2.title: Built on trust
b2.body: Salary and review data stay masked until access is earned — never a guess, never a fake zero.

b3.title: Self-service for everyone
b3.body: Workers see their own payslips, leave, and reviews, and can request adjustments or their data without raising a ticket.

b4.title: Speaks your language
b4.body: Fourteen languages with endonym labels, and full right-to-left support for Arabic and Urdu, built in from day one.

b5.title: A theme and text size for everyone
b5.body: Forty-five themes — including UK NHS and GDS, and the US Web Design System — plus seven text sizes, so the app fits how people actually see and work.

b6.title: Compliant by construction
b6.body: Retention rules, subject-access exports, and the right to be forgotten are built into the product, not bolted on afterwards.

f1.title: Hiring & onboarding
f1.body: Track requisitions and applications on a live board, then guide new hires through onboarding.

f2.title: People & org chart
f2.body: Every worker's profile, reporting line, and org chart, always up to date.

f3.title: Rota & working time
f3.body: Build the rota, flag long hours and short rest breaks, and stay ahead of ergonomic issues.

f4.title: Growth & learning
f4.body: Run review cycles, track training and certificates, and pair mentors with mentees.

f5.title: Wellbeing & pulse
f5.body: Health and benefit entitlements, anonymous pulse surveys, and reasonable-adjustment requests.

f6.title: Payroll & insight
f6.body: Calculate and run payroll, then compare pay and headcount against benchmarks on one dashboard.

trust.title: Privacy, done properly
trust.body: Workers can download their own data or ask for it to be erased, and every retention rule stays visible.

cta.title: Ready to take a look?
cta.body: Sign in with a magic link — no password to remember.

hero.title: See how it all fits together
hero.subhead: A guided look at what Workforce Planning Management actually does, section by section — no sign-in required.

hiring.title: Hiring & onboarding, start to finish
hiring.body: Post a vacancy and it appears as a card on a live requisition board. Candidates move through screening and interviews on that same board, and hiring someone creates their worker record in one step, not two. From day one, a checklist walks new hires through onboarding, and nobody goes live in the roster until it's complete.

people.title: Every person, one profile, one org chart
people.body: Each worker has a single profile that doubles as their self-service hub: payslips, leave balances, reviews, wellbeing prompts, and notifications, all in one place. The org chart builds itself from who reports to whom, so it is never a stale slide deck — reorganize a team and it simply relayouts.

rota.title: Rota, time & working-time safety
rota.body: Build the rota, record time worked, and request leave against the same live balances, with nothing to reconcile between separate systems at month end. Working-time guardrails quietly flag anyone averaging over 48 hours or getting less than 11 hours' rest between shifts, and an ergonomic-assessment checklist catches workstation issues before they become a claim.

growth.title: Reviews, 360s, training & succession
growth.body: Run a review cycle with goals and feedback, or collect a full 360° appraisal from managers, peers, and reports — content stays private until it is explicitly shared, and small groups are protected so no single comment is traceable to one person. Training enrolments, a skills matrix, learning paths, and mentor pairings sit alongside succession plans that flag who is ready to step up, and who is not yet.

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing that respects privacy
wellbeing.body: Health and benefit entitlements prompt the right person at the right time, based only on department, age band, or job title — never on a stored health status. Pulse surveys are anonymous by construction, with results suppressed below five responses so no small team's honest answer is ever traceable back to one person.

payroll.title: Payroll, run with confidence
payroll.body: Calculate a payroll run from salary, hours, and approved overtime, review the payslip breakdown, then approve and pay — every step audited, and an approved run locked from further changes. Benchmarking compares pay and headcount against reference bands, flagging anyone below or above range for a second look.

privacy.title: Privacy built in, not bolted on
privacy.body: Salary and review content render as an honest masked state to anyone who has not earned access — never a fake zero, never a silent error. Every worker can download everything the system holds on them, ask for it to be erased once their employment ends, and see exactly which retention rule applies and when it runs.

multiorg.title: Belong to more than one organization
multiorg.body: Sign in once and see every organization you belong to at the same time — a company, a department, a peer organization, a working group — with no separate switcher to click through. Each membership carries its own role, so being a staff partner in one team and an ordinary member of another is one sign-in, not two accounts.

dashboard.title: One dashboard, the numbers that matter
dashboard.body: Active headcount, open vacancies, and succession gaps sit on one HR dashboard the moment you sign in, each tile a shortcut to the detail behind it. It is the same live data every other page reads, never a separate report that goes stale.

yours.title: Make it look and sound like yours
yours.body: Choose from forty-five themes, including accessible UK NHS, GDS, and US Web Design System variants, pick from seven text sizes, and read the whole app in any of fourteen languages, with proper right-to-left support for Arabic and Urdu. It is the same product, shaped to how each person actually sees and works.

cta.title: Ready to try it yourself?
cta.body: Sign in with a magic link and explore with real data — no password, no commitment.

turnover_high.suggestion: Break leavers down by department and tenure, and compare with pulse-survey and exit feedback.

headcount_shrinking.suggestion: Check whether the reduction was planned; compare with open requisitions and the draft plan.

headcount_growing.suggestion: Check the growth against the budgeted plan and onboarding capacity.

span_wide.suggestion: Look for managers with the widest spans and consider adding a layer or a team lead.

span_narrow.suggestion: Look for layers that could be merged.
